acceptance: Observation, decision input and saved recordings expose the actual observed player game mode and relevant observed abilities, with explicit unknown values and correct refresh after world/mode changes. World name, objective text and recording filename never stand in for mode evidence. Old recordings remain readable with unknown mode rather than fabricated values; client/server disagreement is visible.

The unchanged-block failure is traced through one controlled attempt: target and held item, local validation, actual mining request, outgoing action and server response, and independently confirmed final block state. Compare the pinned public Azalea mining API with the existing queued path when needed to distinguish integration failure from client restriction or server refusal. Apply and document the smallest evidence-supported fix. Simulation, packet send, local prediction and ACK alone cannot establish a successful live break or its cause.

The shared block-breaking path has correct mode-specific outcomes: Creative removal succeeds on an authoritative confirmed block change without requiring a Survival drop; Survival gather succeeds only after the promised valid drop is collected and reflected in authoritative inventory. Correct tool/drop prerequisites and cancellation on explicit stop, disconnect or invalid world identity remain enforced. There is no scene-specific coordinate script or unsupported promise of collection in Creative.

The relevant executable choice list contains only actions with real dispatch paths and honest outcome contracts. Unsupported goals remain visible as labelled knowledge outside the executable answer IDs; supported investigation/planning/acquisition paths remain possible. Wait and continuation remain legitimate choices. Do not force a desired Jev answer, silently lower thresholds, or repeatedly offer an unchanged impossible command just to spend another request.

Saved bounded live evidence confirms Creative removal and Survival collection under measured mode, world and stated initial conditions, and at least one integrated run shows real Jev choosing among several executable alternatives, the chosen action producing the confirmed effect, and the following decision using the updated state. A direct mechanical probe is allowed and labelled as such, but does not replace the Jev-choice evidence. Setup occurs before the autonomous segment; any later operator intervention is recorded and disqualifies that segment as autonomous proof. If prerequisites or a server/library defect block this, preserve the failed evidence and report the blocker through Loop; do not mark this criterion complete.

Meaningful regressions cover the proven cause, mode-specific outcomes and stop/stale-state behavior. The configured checks are run by Loop and pass; an independent review checks these criteria and the recorded effects, and its verdict is submitted unchanged. A short docs/chain-status.md records the current chain, new run ID/configuration, evidence paths/hashes, observed result and still-open broader requirements. Green tests alone are not gameplay completion.

fix.when: Checks or independent review identify concrete failures or gaps

Use only the skill-permitted smallest diagnostic when essential failure detail is missing; do not run confirmatory suites. Distinguish malformed setup, client restrictions, server refusal, prediction and real effects. Follow Route. Do not run configured checks; Loop runs them.

verify.when: The live cause or repaired chain needs server-confirmed evidence

Record requests and server outcomes without credentials. Keep operator setup separate from the autonomous segment, and never change rules mid-run to manufacture success. Report failure honestly. Do not alter server permissions/configuration to bypass a refusal. Follow Route; Loop owns configured checks.
